name: Neon Fuchsia
lede: Neon Fuchsia applies the brightening word "neon" to [[magenta]], though the result reads as a deep pink rather than fuchsia's own purple lean.

sections.title: Brighter than its own parent
sections.body:
Our library traces this name only to a Wikipedia color list, with no first-recorded date given [1]. It modifies [[magenta]] with "neon," but the swatch itself, a saturated deep pink, sits closer to red than to fuchsia's purple lean [1]. A near-duplicate name, Radical Red, sits only 1.4 units away in the same library, two names landing on almost the same pink [1]. The ISCC-NBS dictionary's nearest block is "deep pink," 7.4 units from that block's centre [1].

Its nearest named neighbor is [[fiery-rose|Fiery Rose]], 2.9 units away and duller [2]. [[pink-red|Red-Pink]] sits 3.4 units out, more vivid, and [[watermelon|Watermelon]] 3.5 units out, almost the same color [2]. Measured in LCH it reads lightness 58, chroma 76, hue 19 degrees [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: Our archive finds no painting matching this exact color by the full-canvas measure, though the within-painting lens finds a trace in 1 of 23,781 paintings, rarer than 88 percent of the named colors, as photographed [3]. The sample is too thin here to say more [3].
